Studied: Striking.description:
🥊 You trained in a striking art: boxing, karate, kickboxing or Muay Thai, at a gym, a dojo or on a school team.

🌱 Guard, footwork, punches, kicks, elbows and knees with the hips behind them. You know how to hit without breaking your own hand.
⚠️ A heavy brawler, a heteromorph's armored hide or a Quirk-boosted opponent can still overpower you, and street fights have no referee.
⚖️ Hitting someone outside sport or self-defense is assault, and courts look hard at a trained fighter's claim of self-defense.
🏫 It shows in knuckle calluses, a squared stance when tense and calm on a crowded train.

📈 Grants: Striking +15
